upstream_pin_independently_confirmed: coltrans-planning146b205e33e20ac26975993d32ec89b140754550 git tree has deps/crazyflie-firmware mode160000 SHA b08d9f3cbcc581d8e7f988cabad22c26d35f4a58
roles: Shared payload/tension allocator, shared recovery/formation plan and bounded motor mixer; unchanged upstream controller_lee.c provides position/attitude control.
source_clock: Published default500Hz; wrapper executes source at the shared50Hz controlperiod. Upstream gains remain unchanged; physical mass/inertia calibrated to Menagerie.
reference_derivatives: Position and velocity references supplied. Acceleration feedforward includes shared allocated cable load divided by UAV mass and caller-provided payload acceleration (normally zero). Jerk and yaw-rate references are zero; heading is shared configured constant.
snapshot_contract: Per-UAV controllerLee_t byte state and shared payload integral are captured. Restore assumes identical plant/controller configuration, consistent with the current controller API; cross-configuration restores are not part of this benchmark.
capability_guard: External experiment exposes only rule_fixed/rule_reconfigure; run_mission rejects external controller_factory with learned or true-option planners, preventing a study-controller counterfactual fork mismatch.
